title: Tools
subtitle: Actions your agents can take during a call.
info: A tool is a webhook on your server. The agent calls it mid-conversation with the details it has gathered, and reads your reply back to the caller. Give a tool to an agent in the agent's Capabilities.

empty.title: No tools yet
empty.description: Let your agents check an order, look up a booking or open a ticket in your own system while they talk. A tool is a URL on your server, a line on when to use it, and the details the agent should send.

card.parameters: {count, plural, =0 {No parameters} one {# parameter} other {# parameters}}
card.usedBy: {count, plural, one {Used by # agent} other {Used by # agents}}

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: Agents can no longer call it. This cannot be undone.
delete.descriptionUsed: {agents} will stop using it. This cannot be undone.

toast.created: {name} created. Test it, then give it to an agent.
toast.saved: Saved. Agents use the new settings from their next call.
toast.nameTaken: You already have a tool called {name}. Pick another name.

drawer.createDescription: An action your agents can take during a call. After creating it, give it to an agent in the agent's Capabilities.
drawer.editDescription: Calls your server during a call and reads the reply back to the caller.
drawer.dangerDescription: Every agent that has it loses it. Calls already in progress finish as they are.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: What the agent calls it. Letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
form.description: When should the agent use it?
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Look up where an order is. Use it when the caller asks about a delivery.
form.descriptionHint: The agent decides from this, so say what it does and when.
form.passesInfo: The agent fills these in from the conversation. Describe each one so it knows what to put there.
form.noParameters: No parameters. Add one for each thing the agent needs to send, like an order number.
form.paramDescriptionPlaceholder: The order number the caller reads out
form.timeoutHint: 1 to 30 seconds. The caller hears silence while the agent waits.
form.queryString: The parameters go in the query string.
form.jsonBody: The parameters are sent as the JSON body.
form.headersHint: Sent with every request, for an API key or a bearer token.
form.encrypted: Header values are encrypted and never shown again.

checks.badName: Name: letters, digits and underscores only, starting with a letter or underscore.
checks.urlScheme: URL: start with https:// (or http:// for a server on your own network).
checks.urlPlainHttp: The URL is plain http. Anything the agent sends, and your reply, travels unencrypted.
checks.duplicateParam: Parameter "{name}" is listed more than once.
checks.enumNoOptions: Parameter "{name}" is a choice, but has no options yet. List them separated by commas.
checks.duplicateHeader: Header "{name}" is listed more than once.
checks.invalidJson: The parameters are not valid JSON.
checks.schemaNotObject: The parameters schema must be an object with "type": "object" and a "properties" map.
checks.nestedSchema: This schema has nested or list parameters, which the builder cannot show. Keep editing it as JSON.

test.title: Test it
test.description: Sends exactly what a call would, with your headers. Save your changes first.
test.argumentsHint: What the agent would pass. Filled in from the parameters as a starting point.
test.invalidJson: The arguments are not valid JSON.
test.agentHears: That is what the agent hears back.
